sloka: ततः सुदर्शनं नाम नीलजीमूतसन्निभम्।ऐरावतकुले जातमारुरोह महोदरः ।। ६.६९.२० ।।
transliteration: tataḥ sudarśanaṁ nāma nīlajīmūtasannibham।airāvatakule jātamāruroha mahodaraḥ ।। 6.69.20 ।।

translations.english: Thereafter Mahodara mounted on an elephant born of Airavata (Indra 's elephant) family, by name Sudarsana went.
